scope: Five words × five boundary modes × three actual occurrences; production pack, fresh profile per sequence

findings.classification: Documented policy, not a new implementation bug
findings.behavior: Only space requests autocorrection. Period, comma, newline and period-then-space preserve literal. qrmenü/evdenmişiz are corrupted by space but preserved by other boundaries; actual typo geliyprum also remains uncorrected with those boundaries.

findings.classification: Documented personal learning policy; product tradeoff
findings.behavior: Three yapabilirseniz occurrences reach 3 points/admission with space; punctuation/newline variants stay at 0. Punctuation followed by space does not retrospectively learn.

evidence: InputCoordinator+Personal.swift explicitly excludes boundaries where correction is never attempted; observed results match that rule.
limits: Core tests only; UI not verified in this round.
Boundary alternatives are not a fix for aggressive space autocorrection.
test: BoundaryCommitAuditTests.testBoundaryDecisions passed after correcting a diagnostic-test type qualification; no production changes.
